class IdentifyCommitteeModule(dspy.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # The LLM is a LAST RESORT: used only when the deterministic parser cannot
        # recover a trustworthy committee name from the email text.
        self.fallback = dspy.Predict(dspy.Signature(
            "email_body: str -> committee: str",
            "You are given the raw text of a political fundraising email (from a campaign committee, PAC, "
            "or party committee). Return the name of the political committee that SPONSORED / PAID FOR "
            "the email.\n\n"
            "Where to look, in priority order:\n"
            "1. The FEC disclaimer in the footer. It usually reads 'Paid for by <COMMITTEE NAME>', but it "
            "can also read 'Paid for and authorized by ...', 'Paid political advertisement paid for and "
            "provided in kind by ...', or 'Paid for and approved by ...'. Use the name exactly as it "
            "appears there.\n"
            "2. If there is no disclaimer, use the committee name printed with the footer mailing address, "
            "or the organization soliciting the money (e.g. 'Contributions to <NAME> are not tax "
            "deductible', 'unsubscribe from <NAME>').\n\n"
            "Rules for the output string:\n"
            "- Output ONLY the committee name. Never include 'Paid for by', 'paid political "
            "advertisement', 'provided in kind by', 'and not authorized by any candidate or candidate's "
            "committee', appended clauses such as 'a joint fundraising committee authorized by and "
            "composed of ...', street addresses, PO Boxes, city/state/ZIP, phone numbers, URLs, or "
            "trailing punctuation.\n"
            "- REPRODUCE THE CASING EXACTLY AS PRINTED in the disclaimer. If the disclaimer is written in "
            "ALL CAPS, return the name in ALL CAPS; do NOT convert it to Title Case, and do not otherwise "
            "re-case, re-spell, abbreviate, or expand the name.\n"
            "- Drop any parenthetical aside that follows the name, e.g. a website or acronym in parentheses "
            "such as '(SOMESITE.COM)'. The name ends where the '(' begins.\n"
            "- The disclaimer is often NOT followed by punctuation: ordinary prose (a sentence about the "
            "candidate, an unsubscribe line, an address) can run straight into it. The committee name ends "
            "at the first ordinary lowercase word that is not a connector ('for', 'of', 'and', 'the', "
            "'to'): words like 'is', 'was', 'has', 'who', 'this', 'contributions', 'unsubscribe' begin the "
            "next sentence and are NOT part of the name.\n"
            "- Keep a person's middle initial together with its period (a single capital letter followed "
            "by a period is part of the name, NOT the end of a sentence). Likewise keep abbreviations such "
            "as 'Inc.', 'Jr.', 'U.S.' that belong to the name.\n"
            "- Committee names often contain a NUMERAL used as wordplay, most commonly a single digit "
            "standing in for a word (a candidate name, then a lone digit, then a state or office). Keep "
            "such single digits: they are part of the name. In contrast, a number of TWO OR MORE digits "
            "right after the name is the start of the mailing address (street number, PO Box, ZIP, "
            "phone) and must be dropped along with everything after it.\n"
            "- Email text often glues the committee name directly onto the following word, a web domain, "
            "or an email address with no space (e.g. a name immediately followed by 'www.<something>.org' "
            "or 'http...'). Cut everything from the domain/URL/@-address onward and return only the name "
            "part.\n"
            "- Drop a leading article: return the bare committee name, not 'the <NAME>'.\n"
            "- Line-wrap artifacts also glue two ordinary words together with no space (two names run "
            "together, a name glued to a small word such as 'for'/'of', or the disclaimer word glued to "
            "'by', as in 'authorizedby'). Restore the missing space; elsewhere in the email the correctly "
            "spaced form usually appears, so use that spelling.\n"
            "- Footers frequently print the committee name twice back-to-back (sometimes with the two "
            "copies glued together, sometimes with the second copy running into the next sentence); output "
            "it exactly once, in full.\n"
            "- Never truncate the name early: give the COMPLETE name including every trailing "
            "'for <office/state>' part.\n"
            "- Give no explanation and no quotation marks."
        ))

    def forward(self, **inputs):
        import re
        from collections import Counter

        body = inputs.get("email_body") or ""

        SMALL = {"for", "of", "the", "and", "a", "to", "in", "on", "at", "or"}
        # Lowercase words that may legitimately appear inside a committee name.
        PARTICLES = {"de", "del", "la", "le", "van", "von", "der", "den", "du", "di",
                     "da", "dos", "y", "e", "por", "con", "el", "al"}
        ALLOWED_LOWER = SMALL | PARTICLES
        NAME_PREFIXES = {"mc", "mac", "o", "de", "des", "di", "du", "la", "le", "van",
                         "von", "st", "el", "al", "d", "der", "den"}
        HARD_STOP = {"not", "po", "p.o.", "p.o", "pmb", "suite", "ste", "unsubscribe",
                     "paid", "copyright", "tel", "text", "contributions", "contribution",
                     "authorized", "www", "all", "privacy", "email", "sent", "click",
                     "donate", "box", "united", "address", "no", "if", "this", "via"}
        # Trailing-period tokens whose period belongs to the NAME, not a sentence end.
        ABBREV = {"inc", "llc", "jr", "sr", "st", "mt", "dr", "sen", "rep", "gov",
                  "cmte", "comm", "co", "ltd", "assn", "dept", "natl", "fnd"}
        KEYWORDS = {"for", "of", "committee", "friends", "fund", "pac", "victory",
                    "campaign", "team", "action", "majority", "project", "alliance",
                    "citizens", "americans"}

        # Matches an embedded URL / domain / mail-address start inside a token.
        URL_RE = re.compile(r"(?:https?:|www\.|\.(?:com|org|net|gov|edu|io|co|us|info)\b|@)", re.I)

        def normalize(t: str) -> str:
            """Collapse whitespace and strip invisible/odd characters from email text."""
            for ch in ("\u034f", "\u200b", "\u200c", "\u200d", "\ufeff", "\xa0", "\u00ad"):
                t = t.replace(ch, " ")
            t = t.replace("\u2019", "'").replace("\u2018", "'")
            t = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", t)
            return t.strip()

        text = normalize(body)

        # Frequency of every standalone alphabetic word in the email (lowercased).
        word_counts = Counter(w.lower() for w in re.findall(r"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z']*", text))

        def initial_or_abbrev(tok: str) -> bool:
            """True when a token's trailing period is part of the name.

            Covers middle initials ('B.'), dotted acronyms ('U.S.') and common
            name abbreviations ('Inc.', 'Jr.', 'St.'). Such a period must NOT be
            treated as the end of the disclaimer sentence.
            """
            if not tok.endswith("."):
                return False
            if re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z](?:\.[A-Za-z])*\.", tok):
                return True
            return tok.rstrip(".").lower() in ABBREV

        def is_plain_lowercase_word(tok: str) -> bool:
            """True when the token is an ordinary all-lowercase word (prose, not a name part)."""
            core = tok.strip(".,;:!?'\"“”")
            if not core or not core.isalpha():
                return False
            return core.islower() and core.lower() not in ALLOWED_LOWER

        def split_glued(tok: str) -> list:
            """Split camel-case line-wrap glue ('EmiliaSykes' -> ['Emilia', 'Sykes']).

            Never splits all-caps tokens or right after a name particle (Mc, Mac, De, ...).
            """
            if tok.isupper() or len(tok) < 4:
                return [tok]
            parts = []
            start = 0
            for i in range(1, len(tok)):
                if tok[i].isupper() and tok[i - 1].islower():
                    left = tok[start:i]
                    if len(left) < 2 or left.lower() in NAME_PREFIXES:
                        continue
                    parts.append(left)
                    start = i
            parts.append(tok[start:])
            return [p for p in parts if p]

        def unglue(tok: str) -> list:
            """Split a lowercase-run / all-caps glue ('Rosenfor' -> ['Rosen', 'for'],
            'OFSHERROD' -> ['OF', 'SHERROD']).

            Only splits when the glued token is essentially unique in the email while
            BOTH halves occur elsewhere as standalone words, so ordinary words are safe.
            """
            if len(tok) < 7 or not tok.isalpha():
                return [tok]
            whole = word_counts.get(tok.lower(), 0)
            if whole > 2:
                return [tok]
            best = None
            for i in range(2, len(tok) - 1):
                left, right = tok[:i], tok[i:]
                if len(left) < 2 or len(right) < 2:
                    continue
                cl = word_counts.get(left.lower(), 0)
                cr = word_counts.get(right.lower(), 0)
                if cl < 1 or cr < 1:
                    continue
                if whole <= 1:
                    if min(cl, cr) < 1:
                        continue
                elif min(cl, cr) <= whole:
                    continue
                score = min(cl, cr)
                if best is None or score > best[0]:
                    best = (score, [left, right])
            return best[1] if best else [tok]

        def key_of(words: list) -> str:
            """Spacing/punctuation-insensitive key: lowercase alphanumerics only."""
            return "".join(c.lower() for w in words for c in w if c.isalnum())

        def dedupe_key(words: list) -> list:
            """Collapse a name printed twice back-to-back, ignoring spacing differences."""
            n = len(words)
            for k in range(1, n):
                first, second = words[:k], words[k:]
                a, b = key_of(first), key_of(second)
                if a and a == b:
                    return second if len(second) > len(first) else first
            return words

        def drop_trailing_repeat(words: list) -> list:
            """Drop a trailing block that simply repeats the block just before it.

            Footers often print '<NAME> <NAME> <prose...>' with no punctuation, so after
            truncating the prose we are left with the name twice, e.g.
            ['Friends','of','Katrina','Christiansen','Katrina','Christiansen'].
            """
            n = len(words)
            for m in range(n // 2, 0, -1):
                tail = key_of(words[n - m:])
                prev = key_of(words[n - 2 * m:n - m])
                if tail and tail == prev:
                    return words[:n - m]
            return words

        def cut_at_url(tok: str):
            """Return the name-part of a token that has a URL / domain / email glued on.

            'Projectwww.protectvoting.org' -> 'Project';  'www.NRSC.org' -> ''.
            Returns None when the token contains no URL-like fragment.
            """
            m = URL_RE.search(tok)
            if not m:
                return None
            return tok[:m.start()].strip(".,;:!'\"()[]")

        def digit_break(core: str) -> bool:
            """True when a token beginning with a digit ENDS the committee name.

            A lone single digit inside a name is wordplay for a word ('<Name> 4 <State>')
            and must be kept. A run of two or more digits is a street number, PO Box,
            ZIP or phone number, i.e. the start of the address block.
            """
            m = re.match(r"\d+", core)
            if not m:
                return False
            return len(m.group(0)) > 1

        def tokens_after_disclaimer(rest: str) -> list:
            """Collect the committee-name tokens that follow a 'paid for ... by' marker."""
            toks = rest.split(" ")[:30]
            kept = []
            for j, raw in enumerate(toks):
                tok = raw.strip("*|›‹>«»•·—–_\"“”…")
                if not tok:
                    break
                # A parenthetical aside (website/acronym) terminates the name.
                if tok[:1] in "([{":
                    break
                mp = re.search(r"[\(\[\{]", tok)
                if mp:
                    head = tok[:mp.start()].strip(".,;:!'\"")
                    if head and head.lower() not in HARD_STOP:
                        kept.append(head)
                    break
                core_num = tok.strip(".,;:!'\"")
                if core_num[:1].isdigit() and digit_break(core_num):
                    break
                # A glued URL / domain / email address terminates the name.
                cut = cut_at_url(tok)
                if cut is not None:
                    if cut and cut.lower() not in HARD_STOP:
                        kept.append(cut)
                    break
                low = tok.lower().strip(".,;:!'")
                if low in HARD_STOP or not low:
                    break
                # Ordinary lowercase prose word => the disclaimer sentence is over.
                if j > 0 and is_plain_lowercase_word(tok):
                    break
                if low in ("and", "is", "but", "&"):
                    nxt = toks[j + 1].lower() if j + 1 < len(toks) else ""
                    if nxt.startswith("not") or nxt.startswith("is") or nxt.startswith("author"):
                        break
                if tok[-1] in ".,;:!":
                    if tok[-1] == "." and initial_or_abbrev(tok):
                        kept.append(tok)          # middle initial / abbreviation: keep going
                        if len(kept) >= 20:
                            break
                        continue
                    inner = tok.rstrip(".,;:!")
                    if inner:
                        kept.append(inner)
                    break
                kept.append(tok)
                if len(kept) >= 20:
                    break
            return kept

        def polish(kept: list) -> str:
            words = []
            for tok in kept:
                for part in split_glued(tok):
                    words.extend(unglue(part))
            for _ in range(3):
                new = dedupe_key(words)
                if new == words:
                    break
                words = new
            for _ in range(3):
                new = drop_trailing_repeat(words)
                if new == words:
                    break
                words = new
            if not words:
                return ""
            all_caps = all(c.isupper() for c in "".join(words) if c.isalpha())
            # Drop a leading article ('the NRCC' -> 'NRCC'); keep an intentional 'The'.
            while len(words) > 1 and words[0].lower() == "the" and (words[0].islower() or all_caps):
                words.pop(0)
            # Trim trailing filler: small words and dangling numerals.
            while words and (words[-1].lower() in ALLOWED_LOWER or words[-1].isdigit()):
                words.pop()
            while words and not any(c.isalnum() for c in words[0]):
                words.pop(0)
            if not words:
                return ""
            # Casing is preserved exactly as printed in the email (ALL CAPS stays ALL CAPS).
            return " ".join(words).strip(" .,;:-")

        def suspicious(cand: str) -> bool:
            """True when the extracted name is probably corrupted/truncated -> defer."""
            toks = cand.split()
            if not toks or len(toks) > 9:
                return True
            k = key_of(toks)
            if len(k) < 3:
                return True
            n = len(k)
            if n % 2 == 0 and k[: n // 2] == k[n // 2:]:
                return True  # name still doubled
            if not any(t[:1].isupper() for t in toks):
                return True  # no capitalized word: unlikely to be a proper name
            if URL_RE.search(cand):
                return True  # leftover URL / domain / email debris
            if re.search(r"[A-Za-z]\.[A-Za-z]{3,}", cand):
                return True
            if re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z]\.?", toks[-1]):
                return True  # truncated right at a middle initial
            if len(toks) == 1 and not (toks[0].isupper() or any(c.isdigit() for c in toks[0])):
                return True  # a bare single word is almost never a full committee name
            for i, t in enumerate(toks):
                if i > 0 and is_plain_lowercase_word(t):
                    return True  # ordinary prose word leaked into the name
                if len(t) >= 12 and t.isalpha() and t[1:].islower() \
                        and word_counts.get(t.lower(), 0) <= 1:
                    return True  # long unique lowercase-run token: unresolved glue
            return False

        def deterministic(t: str) -> str:
            """Extract the sponsoring committee from the FEC 'paid for ... by' disclaimer(s)."""
            candidates = []
            # Covers 'paid for by', 'paid for and authorized by', 'paid for and approved by',
            # 'paid for and provided in kind by', and line-wrap glue like 'authorizedby'.
            patterns = [
                r"paid\s*for\s*(?:and\s*(?:\w+\s*){0,3}?)?by",
                r"provided\s+in\s+kind\s*by",
                r"authorized\s+and\s+paid\s*for\s*by",
            ]
            for pattern in patterns:
                for m in re.finditer(pattern, t, re.I):
                    nxt = t[m.end():m.end() + 1]
                    # 'by' swallowed inside a longer word (e.g. 'bystander'): not a marker.
                    if nxt and nxt.isalpha() and nxt.islower():
                        continue
                    rest = t[m.end():].lstrip(" :,-–—.")
                    if not rest:
                        continue
                    cand = polish(tokens_after_disclaimer(rest))
                    if not cand:
                        continue
                    n_words = len(cand.split())
                    if n_words < 1 or n_words > 9:
                        continue
                    if not any(c.isalpha() for c in cand) or len(cand) < 3:
                        continue
                    if cand.lower() in ("the", "a", "an", "any", "our", "this"):
                        continue
                    candidates.append(cand)
                if candidates:
                    break  # prefer the highest-priority disclaimer wording found
            if not candidates:
                return ""
            keys = [key_of(c.split()) for c in candidates]
            counts = Counter(keys)
            best_n = max(counts.values())
            best_key = None
            for kk in keys:
                if counts[kk] == best_n:
                    best_key = kk
                    break
            group = [c for c, kk in zip(candidates, keys) if kk == best_key]
            group.sort(key=lambda c: -len(c.split()))
            return group[0]

        def address_candidate(t: str) -> str:
            """Recover the committee name printed right before the footer mailing address.

            Deliberately conservative: the phrase must look committee-like (contain a word
            such as 'for', 'committee', 'friends', 'fund', 'PAC') AND occur at least twice
            in the email, otherwise we leave the email to the LLM rather than guess.
            """
            text_key = "".join(c.lower() for c in t if c.isalnum())
            best = ""
            addr_re = re.compile(r"(?:\bP\.?\s?O\.?\s+Box\b|\b\d{2,6}\s+[A-Z][a-z])")
            for m in addr_re.finditer(t):
                prefix = t[:m.start()].rstrip(" ,.-–—")
                toks = prefix.split(" ")[-14:]
                acc = []
                for raw in reversed(toks):
                    tok = raw.strip("*|›‹>«»•·—–_[]()\"“”…")
                    if not tok:
                        break
                    if URL_RE.search(tok):
                        break
                    low = tok.lower().strip(".,;:!'")
                    if not low or low in HARD_STOP:
                        break
                    if tok[-1] in ".,;:!?" and not initial_or_abbrev(tok):
                        break
                    core = tok.strip(".,;:!'\"")
                    if core[:1].isdigit() and digit_break(core):
                        break
                    if not (tok[:1].isupper() or low in ALLOWED_LOWER or core.isdigit()):
                        break
                    acc.append(tok)
                    if len(acc) >= 10:
                        break
                cand = polish(list(reversed(acc)))
                if not cand:
                    continue
                parts = cand.split()
                if len(parts) < 2:
                    continue
                if not any(w.lower().strip(".,;:'") in KEYWORDS for w in parts):
                    continue
                k = key_of(parts)
                if len(k) < 6 or text_key.count(k) < 2:
                    continue
                if len(cand) > len(best):
                    best = cand
            return best

        committee = deterministic(text)

        if not committee or suspicious(committee):
            alt = address_candidate(text)
            if alt and not suspicious(alt):
                committee = alt
            else:
                out = self.fallback(email_body=body)
                guess = str(getattr(out, "committee", "") or "").strip().strip('"“”')
                guess = re.sub(r"^\s*paid\s+for\s+(?:and\s+(?:\w+\s+){0,4}?)?by\s+", "",
                               guess, flags=re.I).strip(" .,;:-")
                guess = re.sub(r"^the\s+(?=[A-Z])", "", guess).strip(" .,;:-")
                # Strip a parenthetical aside the LLM may have carried over.
                pm = re.search(r"[\(\[]", guess)
                if pm and guess[: pm.start()].strip(" .,;:-"):
                    guess = guess[: pm.start()].strip(" .,;:-")
                # Strip any URL / email debris the LLM may have carried over.
                m = URL_RE.search(guess)
                if m and guess[: m.start()].strip(" .,;:-"):
                    guess = guess[: m.start()].strip(" .,;:-")
                if guess:
                    committee = guess

        return dspy.Prediction(committee=str(committee).strip())

class IdentifyCommitteeModule(dspy.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Only used when the deterministic extractor cannot recover the disclaimer confidently.
        self.fallback = dspy.Predict(dspy.Signature(
            "email_body: str, disclaimer_snippet: str -> committee: str",
            "You are given the raw text of a political fundraising email (often with markdown "
            "artifacts, collapsed line breaks, image links and footer boilerplate), plus "
            "'disclaimer_snippet': the raw text that immediately follows the legal disclaimer "
            "phrase, if code could find one (it may be empty).\n"
            "TASK: output the name of the political committee that PAID FOR / sponsored the email.\n\n"
            "DOMAIN KNOWLEDGE:\n"
            "- Federal and state law requires a disclaimer, usually near the bottom, of the form "
            "'Paid for by <COMMITTEE NAME>', 'Paid for and authorized by <COMMITTEE NAME>', or "
            "'Contributions to <COMMITTEE NAME> are not deductible...'. The committee name is the "
            "text immediately after that phrase and it normally ENDS with an organizational word "
            "such as Committee, Fund, PAC, Party, Congress, Senate, House, President, Governor, "
            "Campaign, Victory, Inc. or LLC.\n"
            "- Committee names look like 'X for President', 'X for Senate', 'X for Congress', "
            "'X for Governor', 'Friends of X', '<State> Republican State Committee', "
            "'Democratic Party of <State>', '<Name> Victory Fund', "
            "'<Name> Political Action Committee (ACRONYM)', '<Name> JFC Inc.'.\n"
            "- Line breaks are often collapsed, so the sentence that FOLLOWS the committee name can "
            "be glued to it (e.g. the name is immediately followed by prose about the campaign). "
            "Stop at the end of the legal name; never include the following sentence.\n"
            "- Email footers very often REPEAT the committee name twice in a row (once in the "
            "disclaimer, once as the mailing-address header) and then give a postal address, e.g. "
            "'PO Box ...', 'P.O. Box ...', a street number + street name, city, state and ZIP, plus "
            "'United States' and/or a treasurer line. Report the name ONLY ONCE and drop everything "
            "address-related.\n"
            "- The email's visible sender/sign-off (a person, staffer, or 'Team X') is NOT the "
            "committee; only the legally named committee is.\n\n"
            "RULES:\n"
            "1. Return ONLY the committee name: no 'Paid for by' prefix, no duplicated copy of the "
            "name, no trailing period, no mailing address / street number / PO Box / city / state / "
            "ZIP / 'United States', no treasurer clause, no URL, no email address, and no trailing "
            "clause such as ', a joint fundraising committee composed of ...' or 'Not authorized by "
            "any candidate'.\n"
            "2. Drop a parenthetical that is a WEBSITE or URL (anything containing 'www.', 'http', "
            "'.com', '.org', '.net'). KEEP a parenthetical that is a genuine acronym of the name.\n"
            "3. Keep legal suffixes that are part of the name (Inc., LLC, JFC), and keep a year that "
            "is genuinely part of the name.\n"
            "4. Drop a leading 'the' unless the name is unreadable without it.\n"
            "5. If the disclaimer is written in ALL CAPS, convert it to normal title case "
            "(lowercase small words like for, of, the, and), but keep genuine acronyms "
            "(GOP, PAC, JFC, RNC, DNC, NRSC) capitalized.\n"
            "6. Line wrapping may have glued words together (e.g. a first and last name with no "
            "space between them); restore the missing space.\n"
            "7. If no disclaimer exists, infer the sponsoring committee from the sender/branding, "
            "sign-off, footer address block and donation links, and give its most standard name.\n"
            "Output the name and nothing else."
        ))

    def forward(self, **inputs):
        import re

        body = inputs.get("email_body") or ""

        SMALL = {"for", "of", "the", "and", "a", "an", "to", "in", "on", "at", "or"}
        CONNECTORS = SMALL | {"de", "la", "van", "von", "del", "du", "da", "dos", "el"}
        ACRONYMS = {"GOP", "PAC", "PACS", "JFC", "USA", "US", "RNC", "DNC", "NRSC",
                    "NRCC", "DCCC", "DSCC", "NRA", "LLC", "MAGA", "AFL", "CIO", "II", "III", "IV"}
        ABBREV = {"inc", "llc", "co", "corp", "jr", "sr", "st", "mr", "mrs", "ms", "dr",
                  "ltd", "lp", "llp", "pac", "no", "u.s", "d.c"}
        STOP_WORDS = {"not", "are", "is", "was", "were", "will", "unsubscribe", "privacy",
                      "copyright", "contributions", "this", "you", "your", "click", "donate",
                      "please", "sent", "received", "if"}
        # Tokens that mark the start of a postal address / treasurer clause / boilerplate:
        # the committee name always ends BEFORE these.
        ADDR_STOP = {"po", "p.o", "pobox", "box", "suite", "ste", "apt", "floor",
                     "treasurer", "http", "https", "www", "street", "avenue", "ave",
                     "road", "blvd", "boulevard", "parkway", "pkwy", "highway", "hwy",
                     "lane", "©"}
        SUFFIX_OK = {"inc", "llc", "incorporated", "ltd", "lp", "llp", "pac"}
        NAME_TAIL = {"committee", "committees", "fund", "pac", "congress", "senate", "house",
                     "president", "governor", "party", "campaign", "victory", "inc", "inc.",
                     "llc", "assembly", "council", "mayor", "attorney", "general", "jfc",
                     "caucus", "district", "sheriff", "treasurer"}

        CAPS_VOCAB = sorted(
            ["REPUBLICAN", "REPUBLICANS", "DEMOCRATIC", "DEMOCRATS", "DEMOCRAT",
             "COMMITTEE", "COMMITTEES", "NATIONAL", "STATE", "PARTY", "PRESIDENT",
             "PRESIDENTIAL", "SENATE", "SENATORIAL", "CONGRESSIONAL", "CONGRESS",
             "VICTORY", "FUND", "CAMPAIGN", "FRIENDS", "ELECTION", "FEDERAL",
             "POLITICAL", "ACTION", "AMERICA", "AMERICAN", "AMERICANS", "COUNTY",
             "DISTRICT", "GOVERNOR", "ATTORNEY", "GENERAL", "LEADERSHIP", "MAJORITY",
             "HOUSE", "WORKING", "FAMILIES", "PROGRESS", "JOINT", "FUNDRAISING",
             "AUTHORIZED", "CENTRAL", "COUNCIL", "CAUCUS", "SENATORS", "CANDIDATE"],
            key=len, reverse=True)

        URL_RE = re.compile(r"(?:https?://|www\.)|\.(?:com|org|net|us|gov|io|co)\b", re.I)

        def normalize(text: str) -> str:
            """Flatten whitespace, drop markdown emphasis, and restore spaces lost to line wraps."""
            t = text.replace("\u00a0", " ").replace("\u2019", "'")
            t = t.replace("*", " ").replace("_", " ").replace("\r", " ").replace("\n", " ")
            t = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", t)
            # 'Harris forPresident' -> 'Harris for President'. Require the following word to
            # start Upper+lower so genuine acronyms in CamelCase ('AmeriPAC') stay intact,
            # and require >=2 lowercase letters before so 'McCain'/'DeSantis' are untouched.
            t = re.sub(r"([a-z]{2,})([A-Z][a-z])", r"\1 \2", t)
            return t

        def key_of(tok: str) -> str:
            return tok.strip(".,;:()[]<>|\"'").lower()

        def core_of(tok: str) -> str:
            return tok.strip(".,;:()[]<>|\"'")

        def looks_like_url(tok: str) -> bool:
            """True if the token (even wrapped in brackets/parens) is a website or URL."""
            stripped = tok.strip("([{<\"'>)]}")
            if not stripped:
                return False
            low = stripped.lower()
            if low.startswith("http") or low.startswith("www."):
                return True
            return bool(URL_RE.search(low)) and "@" not in low

        def is_lower_prose_word(tok: str) -> bool:
            """True for an ordinary lowercase English word (start of prose, not a name part)."""
            c = core_of(tok)
            if len(c) < 2:
                return False
            if not c[0].isalpha() or not c[0].islower():
                return False
            if key_of(tok) in CONNECTORS:
                return False
            return all(ch.isalpha() or ch in "'-" for ch in c)

        def is_addr_start(toks: list, i: int) -> bool:
            """True if token i begins a postal address / boilerplate block, so the name ends here."""
            tok = toks[i]
            low = key_of(tok)
            if low in ADDR_STOP:
                return True
            if low == "united" and i + 1 < len(toks) and key_of(toks[i + 1]).startswith("state"):
                return True
            if re.match(r"^\d{5}(?:-\d{4})?$", low):
                return True
            if re.match(r"^\d", low):
                # A bare 4-digit year can legitimately be part of a committee name
                # ('... for President 2024'); any other leading-digit token is a street
                # number, PO box number, ZIP or similar address artifact.
                if re.match(r"^\d{4}$", low) and 1900 <= int(low) <= 2099:
                    return False
                return True
            return False

        def split_caps_token(tok: str) -> list:
            """Split a glued ALL-CAPS token using a vocabulary of committee words."""
            parts = []
            cur = tok
            for _ in range(4):
                if len(cur) <= 5:
                    break
                found = None
                for w in CAPS_VOCAB:
                    if cur.endswith(w) and len(cur) > len(w) + 2:
                        found = w
                        break
                if not found:
                    break
                parts.insert(0, found)
                cur = cur[: len(cur) - len(found)]
            if parts:
                return [cur] + parts
            return [tok]

        def title_word(tok: str) -> str:
            core = tok.strip(".,'\"")
            if core in ACRONYMS:
                return tok
            return tok.title()

        def drop_repeat(name: str) -> str:
            """Footers usually print the committee name twice ('X Y X Y'); keep one copy."""
            toks = [t for t in name.split(" ") if t]
            n = len(toks)
            keys = [key_of(t) for t in toks]
            for k in range(2, n):
                rest = keys[k:]
                if len(rest) >= 2 and rest == keys[: len(rest)]:
                    return " ".join(toks[:k])
            return name

        def trim_address(name: str) -> str:
            """Second-pass repair: cut anything from the first address-looking token onward."""
            toks = [t for t in name.split(" ") if t]
            keep = []
            for i in range(len(toks)):
                if is_addr_start(toks, i):
                    break
                keep.append(toks[i])
            return " ".join(keep).strip(" ,;:|-")

        def trim_to_tail(name: str) -> str:
            """Cut the candidate at the end of its legal name.

            Committee names end with an organizational word (Committee, Fund, PAC, Party,
            Congress, Senate, President, Inc., ...). Anchor on the LAST capitalized such word,
            then allow only legitimate continuations: a connector + capitalized word
            ('Party of Wisconsin'), another organizational word, a legal suffix, a 4-digit
            year, or a parenthesized acronym. Everything after that (glued prose, a website
            in parentheses, a repeated copy of the name, an address) is dropped.
            """
            toks = [t for t in name.split(" ") if t]
            if not toks:
                return name
            anchor = -1
            for i, t in enumerate(toks):
                c = core_of(t)
                if not c:
                    continue
                if c[0].isupper() and key_of(t) in NAME_TAIL:
                    anchor = i
            if anchor < 0:
                return name
            end = anchor
            i = anchor + 1
            for _ in range(6):
                if i >= len(toks):
                    break
                # connector(s) followed by a capitalized word: 'Party of Wisconsin'
                j = i
                smalls = 0
                while j < len(toks) and smalls < 2 and key_of(toks[j]) in CONNECTORS:
                    j += 1
                    smalls += 1
                if smalls > 0 and j < len(toks):
                    c = core_of(toks[j])
                    if c and (c[0].isupper() or c.isupper()):
                        end = j
                        i = j + 1
                        continue
                tok = toks[i]
                k = key_of(tok)
                c = core_of(tok)
                if k in NAME_TAIL or k in SUFFIX_OK or re.match(r"^\d{4}$", k):
                    end = i
                    i += 1
                    continue
                # parenthesized acronym that belongs to the name, e.g. '(SOMEPAC)'
                if tok.startswith("(") and c and not looks_like_url(tok) \
                        and any(ch.isupper() for ch in c) and c.replace("-", "").isalpha():
                    end = i
                    i += 1
                    continue
                break
            return " ".join(toks[: end + 1]).strip(" ,;:|")

        def clean_segment(seg: str) -> str:
            """Trim the text following a 'Paid for by' phrase down to the committee name."""
            toks = [x for x in seg.split(" ") if x]
            if not toks:
                return ""
            alpha_toks = [x for x in toks if any(c.isalpha() for c in x)][:3]
            caps_mode = (bool(alpha_toks)
                         and all(x.upper() == x for x in alpha_toks)
                         and any(len(x) >= 4 for x in alpha_toks))

            kept = []
            for i, tok in enumerate(toks):
                low = key_of(tok)
                if looks_like_url(tok) or "@" in tok or tok in {"|", "---", "--", "-", "="}:
                    break
                if low in STOP_WORDS:
                    break
                if is_addr_start(toks, i):
                    break
                if low == "a" and i + 1 < len(toks) and toks[i + 1].lower().startswith("joint"):
                    break
                if any(c.isalpha() for c in tok) and caps_mode and tok.upper() != tok:
                    break
                # Collapsed line breaks glue the following sentence onto the name; an ordinary
                # lowercase word (not a connector like 'for'/'of'/'the') ends the name.
                if kept and not caps_mode and is_lower_prose_word(tok):
                    break
                kept.append(tok)
                if len(kept) >= 16:
                    break
                if tok.endswith(("!", "?", ";", ":")):
                    break
                if tok.endswith(","):
                    nxt = toks[i + 1].strip(".,").lower() if i + 1 < len(toks) else ""
                    if nxt not in SUFFIX_OK:
                        break
                elif tok.endswith("."):
                    core = tok[:-1].strip(",")
                    if not (core.lower() in ABBREV or len(core) <= 1):
                        break

            out = " ".join(kept).strip()
            for _ in range(5):
                if out and out[-1] in ",;:|":
                    out = out[:-1].strip()
                else:
                    break
            if out.endswith("."):
                lastw = out.split(" ")[-1][:-1]
                if lastw.lower() not in ABBREV and len(lastw) > 1:
                    out = out[:-1].strip()
            out = out.strip(" -–—|")
            if not out:
                return ""

            expanded = []
            for tok in out.split(" "):
                if tok.isalpha() and tok.isupper():
                    expanded.extend(split_caps_token(tok))
                else:
                    expanded.append(tok)

            joined = " ".join(expanded)
            letters = [c for c in joined if c.isalpha()]
            all_caps = bool(letters) and all(c.isupper() for c in letters)
            if all_caps:
                final = []
                for j, tok in enumerate(expanded):
                    core = tok.strip(".,'\"").lower()
                    if tok.strip(".,'\"") in ACRONYMS:
                        final.append(tok)
                    elif j > 0 and core in SMALL:
                        final.append(tok.lower())
                    else:
                        final.append(title_word(tok))
                joined = " ".join(final)

            joined = re.sub(r"^[Tt]he\s+", "", joined).strip()
            joined = trim_address(joined)
            joined = drop_repeat(joined)
            joined = trim_to_tail(joined)
            joined = re.sub(r"\s*\([^)]*(?:www\.|https?://|\.com|\.org|\.net)[^)]*\)\s*$",
                            "", joined, flags=re.I)
            return joined.strip(" ,;:|")

        def suspicious(c: str) -> bool:
            """True when a candidate still looks like it swallowed address/boilerplate text."""
            low = c.lower()
            if re.search(r"\b\d{5}(?:-\d{4})?\b", c):
                return True
            if re.search(r"\b(?:p\.?\s*o\.?\s*box|box|suite|ste|apt|street|avenue|ave|road|"
                         r"blvd|boulevard|parkway|highway)\b", low):
                return True
            if "treasurer" in low or "united states" in low:
                return True
            if URL_RE.search(low) or "@" in c:
                return True
            if len(c.split()) > 11 or len(c) > 85:
                return True
            return False

        def is_valid(c: str) -> bool:
            """Sanity-check a candidate committee name."""
            if not c or len(c) < 3:
                return False
            if not any(ch.isalpha() for ch in c):
                return False
            words = c.split()
            if len(words) == 0:
                return False
            if words[0].lower() in STOP_WORDS:
                return False
            if suspicious(c):
                return False
            # A name made only of lowercase prose words is not a committee name.
            if all(is_lower_prose_word(w) for w in words):
                return False
            return True

        text = normalize(body)

        patterns = [
            re.compile(r"paid\s*for\s*(?:and\s*authorized\s*)?by\b[:,]?\s*", re.I),
            re.compile(r"authorized\s*(?:and\s*paid\s*for\s*)?by\b[:,]?\s*", re.I),
            re.compile(r"contributions\s*(?:to|made\s*to)\s+", re.I),
        ]

        found = ""
        snippet = ""
        for pat in patterns:
            matches = list(pat.finditer(text))
            for m in reversed(matches):
                raw = text[m.end(): m.end() + 240]
                if not snippet and raw.strip():
                    snippet = raw.strip()[:200]
                cand = clean_segment(raw)
                if is_valid(cand):
                    found = cand
                    break
            if found:
                break

        if found:
            return dspy.Prediction(committee=str(found))

        # Secondary deterministic heuristic: the footer usually prints the committee name
        # immediately before the mailing address ('<Name> PO Box ...' / '<Name> 123 Main St ...').
        addr_pat = re.compile(r"(?:P\.?\s*O\.?\s*Box\b|\b\d{1,6}\s+[A-Z][A-Za-z'.\-]+\s+"
                              r"(?:Street|St\.?|Avenue|Ave\.?|Road|Rd\.?|Blvd\.?|Boulevard|"
                              r"Drive|Dr\.?|Lane|Ln\.?|Way|Court|Ct\.?|Place|Pl\.?)\b)")
        name_tok = re.compile(r"^(?:[A-Z][\w'&.\-]*|for|of|the|and|de|la)$")
        best = ""
        for m in addr_pat.finditer(text):
            prefix_toks = [t for t in text[max(0, m.start() - 200): m.start()].split(" ") if t]
            run = []
            for tok in reversed(prefix_toks[-12:]):
                if name_tok.match(tok) and not looks_like_url(tok):
                    run.insert(0, tok)
                else:
                    # Stop at the first non-name token instead of discarding the run.
                    break
            while run and key_of(run[0]) in SMALL:
                run = run[1:]
            if not run:
                continue
            if key_of(run[-1]) not in NAME_TAIL:
                continue
            cand = drop_repeat(re.sub(r"^[Tt]he\s+", "", " ".join(run)).strip())
            cand = trim_to_tail(cand).strip(" ,;:|.")
            if is_valid(cand):
                best = cand
        if best:
            return dspy.Prediction(committee=str(best))

        out = self.fallback(email_body=body, disclaimer_snippet=snippet)
        name = str(getattr(out, "committee", "") or "").strip()
        name = re.sub(r"(?i)^paid\s+for\s+(and\s+authorized\s+)?by[:,]?\s*", "", name).strip()
        name = name.strip(" \"'*|")
        if name.endswith("."):
            lastw = name.split(" ")[-1][:-1]
            if lastw.lower() not in ABBREV and len(lastw) > 1:
                name = name[:-1].strip()
        name = re.sub(r"\s*\([^)]*(?:www\.|https?://|\.com|\.org|\.net)[^)]*\)\s*$",
                      "", name, flags=re.I)
        name = trim_address(name) or name
        name = drop_repeat(name)
        return dspy.Prediction(committee=name.strip(" ,;:|"))

class IdentifyCommitteeModule(dspy.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Only used when the deterministic extractor cannot recover the disclaimer confidently.
        self.fallback = dspy.Predict(dspy.Signature(
            "email_body: str, disclaimer_snippet: str -> committee: str",
            "You are given the raw text of a political fundraising email (often with markdown "
            "artifacts, collapsed line breaks, image links and footer boilerplate), plus "
            "'disclaimer_snippet': the raw text that immediately follows the legal disclaimer "
            "phrase, if code could find one (it may be empty).\n"
            "TASK: output the name of the political committee that PAID FOR / sponsored the email.\n\n"
            "DOMAIN KNOWLEDGE:\n"
            "- Federal and state law requires a disclaimer, usually near the bottom, of the form "
            "'Paid for by <COMMITTEE NAME>', 'Paid for and authorized by <COMMITTEE NAME>', or "
            "'Contributions to <COMMITTEE NAME> are not deductible...'. The committee name is the "
            "text immediately after that phrase and it normally ENDS with an organizational word "
            "such as Committee, Fund, PAC, Project, Party, Congress, Senate, House, President, "
            "Governor, Campaign, Victory, Inc. or LLC.\n"
            "- Committee names look like 'X for President', 'X for Senate', 'X for Congress', "
            "'X for Governor', 'X for <State>', 'Friends of X', '<State> Republican State "
            "Committee', 'Democratic Party of <State>', '<Name> Victory Fund', '<Cause> Project', "
            "'<Name> Political Action Committee (ACRONYM)', '<Name> JFC Inc.'.\n"
            "- Line breaks and mail-client wrapping are often collapsed, so the committee name can "
            "be GLUED to whatever follows it: a website ('...Projectwww.example.org'), a PO Box, a "
            "street number, or the next sentence. Recover the full legal name, then stop exactly "
            "at its end.\n"
            "- Boilerplate that frequently follows the name and is NEVER part of it: 'Not "
            "authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee', 'Use of military rank, job "
            "titles, and photographs in uniform does not imply endorsement...', 'Contributions "
            "are not tax deductible', 'All rights reserved', unsubscribe/privacy text.\n"
            "- Email footers very often REPEAT the committee name twice in a row (once in the "
            "disclaimer, once as the mailing-address header) and then give a postal address, e.g. "
            "'PO Box ...', a street number + street name, city, state and ZIP, plus 'United "
            "States' and/or a treasurer line. Report the name ONLY ONCE and drop everything "
            "address-related.\n"
            "- The email's visible sender/sign-off (a person, staffer, or 'Team X') is NOT the "
            "committee; only the legally named committee is.\n\n"
            "RULES:\n"
            "1. Return ONLY the committee name: no 'Paid for by' prefix, no duplicated copy of the "
            "name, no trailing period, no mailing address / street number / PO Box / city / state / "
            "ZIP / 'United States', no treasurer clause, no URL, no email address, and no trailing "
            "clause such as ', a joint fundraising committee composed of ...' or 'Not authorized by "
            "any candidate'.\n"
            "2. Drop a parenthetical or glued string that is a WEBSITE or URL (anything containing "
            "'www.', 'http', '.com', '.org', '.net'). KEEP a parenthetical that is a genuine "
            "acronym of the name.\n"
            "3. Keep legal suffixes that are part of the name (Inc., LLC, JFC), and keep a year that "
            "is genuinely part of the name.\n"
            "4. Drop a leading 'the' unless the name is unreadable without it. Never end the name "
            "with a connector word such as 'of', 'for', 'and', or 'the'.\n"
            "5. If the disclaimer is written in ALL CAPS, convert it to normal title case "
            "(lowercase small words like for, of, the, and), but keep genuine acronyms "
            "(GOP, PAC, JFC, RNC, DNC, NRSC) capitalized.\n"
            "6. Line wrapping may have glued words together (e.g. 'BYMONDAIRE', a first and last "
            "name with no space, or a name fused to a URL); restore the missing space and report "
            "the complete name.\n"
            "7. If no disclaimer exists, infer the sponsoring committee from the sender/branding, "
            "sign-off, footer address block and donation links, and give its most standard name.\n"
            "Output the name and nothing else."
        ))

    def forward(self, **inputs):
        import re

        body = inputs.get("email_body") or ""

        SMALL = {"for", "of", "the", "and", "a", "an", "to", "in", "on", "at", "or"}
        CONNECTORS = SMALL | {"de", "la", "van", "von", "del", "du", "da", "dos", "el"}
        ACRONYMS = {"GOP", "PAC", "PACS", "JFC", "USA", "US", "RNC", "DNC", "NRSC",
                    "NRCC", "DCCC", "DSCC", "NRA", "LLC", "MAGA", "AFL", "CIO", "II", "III", "IV"}
        ABBREV = {"inc", "llc", "co", "corp", "jr", "sr", "st", "mr", "mrs", "ms", "dr",
                  "ltd", "lp", "llp", "pac", "no", "u.s", "d.c"}

                      "please", "sent", "received", "if"}

                     "treasurer", "http", "https", "www", "street", "avenue", "ave",
                     "road", "blvd", "boulevard", "parkway", "pkwy", "highway", "hwy",
                     "lane", "©"}
        SUFFIX_OK = {"inc", "llc", "incorporated", "ltd", "lp", "llp", "pac"}
        # Organizational words that legitimately END a committee name.
        NAME_TAIL = {"committee", "committees", "fund", "funds", "pac", "pacs", "congress",
                     "senate", "house", "president", "governor", "party", "campaign",
                     "victory", "inc", "inc.", "llc", "assembly", "council", "mayor",
                     "attorney", "general", "jfc", "caucus", "district", "sheriff",
                     "treasurer", "project", "action", "alliance", "coalition", "network",
                     "association", "club", "movement", "organization", "leadership",
                     "majority", "senatorial", "congressional", "america", "americans",
                     "prosperity", "future", "forward", "values", "freedom", "liberty"}

        CAPS_VOCAB = sorted(
            ["REPUBLICAN", "REPUBLICANS", "DEMOCRATIC", "DEMOCRATS", "DEMOCRAT",
             "COMMITTEE", "COMMITTEES", "NATIONAL", "STATE", "PARTY", "PRESIDENT",
             "PRESIDENTIAL", "SENATE", "SENATORIAL", "CONGRESSIONAL", "CONGRESS",
             "VICTORY", "FUND", "CAMPAIGN", "FRIENDS", "ELECTION", "FEDERAL",
             "POLITICAL", "ACTION", "AMERICA", "AMERICAN", "AMERICANS", "COUNTY",
             "DISTRICT", "GOVERNOR", "ATTORNEY", "GENERAL", "LEADERSHIP", "MAJORITY",
             "HOUSE", "WORKING", "FAMILIES", "PROGRESS", "JOINT", "FUNDRAISING",
             "AUTHORIZED", "CENTRAL", "COUNCIL", "CAUCUS", "SENATORS", "CANDIDATE",
             "PROJECT"],
            key=len, reverse=True)

        URL_RE = re.compile(r"(?:https?://|www\.)|\.(?:com|org|net|us|gov|io|co)\b", re.I)

        # Legal / administrative boilerplate that follows the committee name in disclaimers.
        BOILER_RE = re.compile(
            r"\b(?:not\s+authorized\s+by|use\s+of\s+(?:military|photograph|the\s+military)|"
            r"all\s+rights\s+reserved|this\s+(?:email|message)\s+was|to\s+unsubscribe|"
            r"unsubscribe|privacy\s+policy|click\s+here|if\s+you\s+(?:no\s+longer|would|wish|"
            r"prefer|do\s+not)|a\s+joint\s+fundraising|paid\s+for\s+(?:and\s+authorized\s+)?by|"
            r"contributions?\s+(?:to|are|of|made))\b", re.I)

        def normalize(text: str) -> str:
            """Flatten whitespace, drop markdown emphasis, and restore spaces lost to line wraps."""
            t = text.replace("\u00a0", " ").replace("\u2019", "'")
            t = t.replace("*", " ").replace("_", " ").replace("\r", " ").replace("\n", " ")
            t = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", t)
            # 'Harris forPresident' -> 'Harris for President'. Require the following word to
            # start Upper+lower so genuine acronyms in CamelCase ('AmeriPAC') stay intact,
            # and require >=2 lowercase letters before so 'McCain'/'DeSantis' are untouched.
            t = re.sub(r"([a-z]{2,})([A-Z][a-z])", r"\1 \2", t)
            # A name is often fused to a website: '...Projectwww.example.org'.
            t = re.sub(r"(?<=[A-Za-z])(?=(?:www\.|https?://))", " ", t)
            # A name fused to a PO Box or a street number: '...SenatePO Box 12' / '...Fund123 Main'.
            t = re.sub(r"(?<=[A-Za-z])(?=P\.?\s?O\.?\s*Box\b)", " ", t)
            t = re.sub(r"(?<=[a-z])(?=\d{1,6}\s+[A-Z])", " ", t)
            # The disclaimer phrase itself is often fused to the name: 'PAID FOR BYMONDAIRE ...'.
            t = re.sub(r"(?i)(paid\s*for\s*(?:and\s*authorized\s*)?by)(?=[A-Z])", r"\1 ", t)
            t = re.sub(r"(?i)(authorized\s*(?:and\s*paid\s*for\s*)?by)(?=[A-Z])", r"\1 ", t)
            t = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", t)
            return t

        def key_of(tok: str) -> str:
            return tok.strip(".,;:()[]<>|\"'").lower()

        def core_of(tok: str) -> str:
            return tok.strip(".,;:()[]<>|\"'")

        def looks_like_url(tok: str) -> bool:
            """True if the token (even wrapped in brackets/parens) is a website or URL."""
            stripped = tok.strip("([{<\"'>)]}")
            if not stripped:
                return False
            low = stripped.lower()
            if low.startswith("http") or low.startswith("www."):
                return True
            return bool(URL_RE.search(low)) and "@" not in low

        def is_lower_prose_word(tok: str) -> bool:
            """True for an ordinary lowercase English word (start of prose, not a name part)."""
            c = core_of(tok)
            if len(c) < 2:
                return False
            if not c[0].isalpha() or not c[0].islower():
                return False
            if key_of(tok) in CONNECTORS:
                return False
            return all(ch.isalpha() or ch in "'-" for ch in c)

        def is_addr_start(toks: list, i: int) -> bool:
            """True if token i begins a postal address / boilerplate block, so the name ends here."""
            tok = toks[i]
            low = key_of(tok)
            if low in ADDR_STOP:
                return True
            if low == "united" and i + 1 < len(toks) and key_of(toks[i + 1]).startswith("state"):
                return True
            if re.match(r"^\d{5}(?:-\d{4})?$", low):
                return True
            if re.match(r"^\d", low):
                # A bare 4-digit year can legitimately be part of a committee name
                # ('... for President 2024'); any other leading-digit token is a street
                # number, PO box number, ZIP or similar address artifact.
                if re.match(r"^\d{4}$", low) and 1900 <= int(low) <= 2099:
                    return False
                return True
            if low.startswith("#"):
                return True
            return False

        def cut_boilerplate(seg: str) -> str:
            """Truncate the raw post-disclaimer text at the first legal/admin boilerplate phrase."""
            m = BOILER_RE.search(seg)
            if m and m.start() > 0:
                return seg[: m.start()]
            if m and m.start() == 0:
                return ""
            return seg

        def split_caps_token(tok: str) -> list:
            """Split a glued ALL-CAPS token using a vocabulary of committee words."""
            parts = []
            cur = tok
            for _ in range(4):
                if len(cur) <= 5:
                    break
                found = None
                for w in CAPS_VOCAB:
                    if cur.endswith(w) and len(cur) > len(w) + 2:
                        found = w
                        break
                if not found:
                    break
                parts.insert(0, found)
                cur = cur[: len(cur) - len(found)]
            if parts:
                return [cur] + parts
            return [tok]

        def title_word(tok: str) -> str:
            core = tok.strip(".,'\"")
            if core in ACRONYMS:
                return tok
            return tok.title()

        def drop_repeat(name: str) -> str:
            """Footers usually print the committee name twice ('X Y X Y'); keep one copy."""
            toks = [t for t in name.split(" ") if t]
            n = len(toks)
            keys = [key_of(t) for t in toks]
            for k in range(2, n):
                rest = keys[k:]
                if len(rest) >= 2 and rest == keys[: len(rest)]:
                    return " ".join(toks[:k])
            return name

        def trim_address(name: str) -> str:
            """Second-pass repair: cut anything from the first address-looking token onward."""
            toks = [t for t in name.split(" ") if t]
            keep = []
            for i in range(len(toks)):
                if is_addr_start(toks, i):
                    break
                keep.append(toks[i])
            return " ".join(keep).strip(" ,;:|-")

        def strip_edge_connectors(name: str) -> str:
            """A committee name never begins or ends with a connector word like 'of'/'for'."""
            toks = [t for t in name.split(" ") if t]
            for _ in range(4):
                if toks and key_of(toks[-1]) in CONNECTORS:
                    toks.pop()
                else:
                    break
            for _ in range(2):
                if toks and key_of(toks[0]) in SMALL:
                    toks = toks[1:]
                else:
                    break
            return " ".join(toks)

        def trim_to_tail(name: str) -> str:
            """Cut the candidate at the end of its legal name.

            Committee names end with an organizational word (Committee, Fund, PAC, Party,
            Congress, Senate, President, Project, Inc., ...). Anchor on the LAST capitalized such
            word, then allow only legitimate continuations: a connector + capitalized word
            ('Party of Wisconsin'), another organizational word, a legal suffix, a 4-digit
            year, or a parenthesized acronym. Everything after that (glued prose, a website
            in parentheses, a repeated copy of the name, an address) is dropped.
            """
            toks = [t for t in name.split(" ") if t]
            if not toks:
                return name
            anchor = -1
            for i, t in enumerate(toks):
                c = core_of(t)
                if not c:
                    continue
                if c[0].isupper() and key_of(t) in NAME_TAIL:
                    anchor = i
            if anchor < 0:
                return name
            end = anchor
            i = anchor + 1
            for _ in range(6):
                if i >= len(toks):
                    break
                # connector(s) followed by a capitalized word: 'Party of Wisconsin'
                j = i
                smalls = 0
                while j < len(toks) and smalls < 2 and key_of(toks[j]) in CONNECTORS:
                    j += 1
                    smalls += 1
                if smalls > 0 and j < len(toks):
                    c = core_of(toks[j])
                    if c and (c[0].isupper() or c.isupper()):
                        end = j
                        i = j + 1
                        continue
                tok = toks[i]
                k = key_of(tok)
                c = core_of(tok)
                if k in NAME_TAIL or k in SUFFIX_OK or re.match(r"^\d{4}$", k):
                    end = i
                    i += 1
                    continue
                # parenthesized acronym that belongs to the name, e.g. '(SOMEPAC)'
                if tok.startswith("(") and c and not looks_like_url(tok) \
                        and any(ch.isupper() for ch in c) and c.replace("-", "").isalpha():
                    end = i
                    i += 1
                    continue
                break
            return " ".join(toks[: end + 1]).strip(" ,;:|")

        def clean_segment(seg: str) -> str:
            """Trim the text following a 'Paid for by' phrase down to the committee name."""
            seg = cut_boilerplate(seg)
            toks = [x for x in seg.split(" ") if x]
            if not toks:
                return ""
            alpha_toks = [x for x in toks if any(c.isalpha() for c in x)][:3]
            caps_mode = (bool(alpha_toks)
                         and all(x.upper() == x for x in alpha_toks)
                         and any(len(x) >= 4 for x in alpha_toks))

            kept = []
            for i, tok in enumerate(toks):
                low = key_of(tok)
                if looks_like_url(tok) or "@" in tok or tok in {"|", "---", "--", "-", "="}:
                    break
                if low in STOP_WORDS:
                    break
                if is_addr_start(toks, i):
                    break
                if low == "a" and i + 1 < len(toks) and toks[i + 1].lower().startswith("joint"):
                    break
                if any(c.isalpha() for c in tok) and caps_mode and tok.upper() != tok:
                    break
                # Collapsed line breaks glue the following sentence onto the name; an ordinary
                # lowercase word (not a connector like 'for'/'of'/'the') ends the name.
                if kept and not caps_mode and is_lower_prose_word(tok):
                    break
                kept.append(tok)
                if len(kept) >= 16:
                    break
                if tok.endswith(("!", "?", ";", ":")):
                    break
                if tok.endswith(","):
                    nxt = toks[i + 1].strip(".,").lower() if i + 1 < len(toks) else ""
                    if nxt not in SUFFIX_OK:
                        break
                elif tok.endswith("."):
                    core = tok[:-1].strip(",")
                    if not (core.lower() in ABBREV or len(core) <= 1):
                        break

            out = " ".join(kept).strip()
            for _ in range(5):
                if out and out[-1] in ",;:|":
                    out = out[:-1].strip()
                else:
                    break
            if out.endswith("."):
                lastw = out.split(" ")[-1][:-1]
                if lastw.lower() not in ABBREV and len(lastw) > 1:
                    out = out[:-1].strip()
            out = out.strip(" -–—|")
            if not out:
                return ""

            expanded = []
            for tok in out.split(" "):
                if tok.isalpha() and tok.isupper():
                    expanded.extend(split_caps_token(tok))
                else:
                    expanded.append(tok)

            joined = " ".join(expanded)
            letters = [c for c in joined if c.isalpha()]
            all_caps = bool(letters) and all(c.isupper() for c in letters)
            if all_caps:
                final = []
                for j, tok in enumerate(expanded):
                    core = tok.strip(".,'\"").lower()
                    if tok.strip(".,'\"") in ACRONYMS:
                        final.append(tok)
                    elif j > 0 and core in SMALL:
                        final.append(tok.lower())
                    else:
                        final.append(title_word(tok))
                joined = " ".join(final)

            joined = re.sub(r"^[Tt]he\s+", "", joined).strip()
            joined = trim_address(joined)
            joined = drop_repeat(joined)
            joined = trim_to_tail(joined)
            joined = re.sub(r"\s*\([^)]*(?:www\.|https?://|\.com|\.org|\.net)[^)]*\)\s*$",
                            "", joined, flags=re.I)
            joined = strip_edge_connectors(joined)
            return joined.strip(" ,;:|")

        def suspicious(c: str) -> bool:
            """True when a candidate still looks like it swallowed address/boilerplate text."""
            low = c.lower()
            if re.search(r"\b\d{5}(?:-\d{4})?\b", c):
                return True
            if re.search(r"\b(?:p\.?\s*o\.?\s*box|box|suite|ste|apt|street|avenue|ave|road|"
                         r"blvd|boulevard|parkway|highway)\b", low):
                return True
            if "treasurer" in low or "united states" in low:
                return True
            if URL_RE.search(low) or "@" in c:
                return True
            if len(c.split()) > 11 or len(c) > 85:
                return True
            return False

        def is_valid(c: str) -> bool:
            """Sanity-check a candidate committee name."""
            if not c or len(c) < 3:
                return False
            if not any(ch.isalpha() for ch in c):
                return False
            words = c.split()
            if len(words) == 0:
                return False
            if words[0].lower() in STOP_WORDS:
                return False
            if suspicious(c):
                return False
            # A name made only of lowercase prose words is not a committee name.
            if all(is_lower_prose_word(w) for w in words):
                return False
            return True

        text = normalize(body)

        patterns = [
            re.compile(r"paid\s*for\s*(?:and\s*authorized\s*)?by\b[:,]?\s*", re.I),
            re.compile(r"authorized\s*(?:and\s*paid\s*for\s*)?by\b[:,]?\s*", re.I),
            re.compile(r"contributions\s*(?:to|made\s*to)\s+", re.I),
        ]

        found = ""
        snippet = ""
        for pat in patterns:
            matches = list(pat.finditer(text))
            for m in reversed(matches):
                raw = text[m.end(): m.end() + 240]
                if not snippet and raw.strip():
                    snippet = raw.strip()[:200]
                cand = clean_segment(raw)
                if is_valid(cand):
                    found = cand
                    break
            if found:
                break

        if found:
            return dspy.Prediction(committee=str(found))

        # Secondary deterministic heuristic: the footer usually prints the committee name
        # immediately before the mailing address ('<Name> PO Box ...' / '<Name> 123 Main St ...').
        addr_pat = re.compile(r"(?:P\.?\s*O\.?\s*Box\b|\b\d{1,6}\s+[A-Z][A-Za-z'.\-]+\s+"
                              r"(?:Street|St\.?|Avenue|Ave\.?|Road|Rd\.?|Blvd\.?|Boulevard|"
                              r"Drive|Dr\.?|Lane|Ln\.?|Way|Court|Ct\.?|Place|Pl\.?)\b)")
        name_tok = re.compile(r"^(?:[A-Z][\w'&.\-]*|for|of|the|and|de|la)$")
        best = ""
        for m in addr_pat.finditer(text):
            prefix_toks = [t for t in text[max(0, m.start() - 200): m.start()].split(" ") if t]
            run = []
            for tok in reversed(prefix_toks[-12:]):
                if name_tok.match(tok) and not looks_like_url(tok):
                    run.insert(0, tok)
                else:
                    # Stop at the first non-name token instead of discarding the run.
                    break
            while run and key_of(run[0]) in SMALL:
                run = run[1:]
            if not run:
                continue
            if key_of(run[-1]) not in NAME_TAIL:
                continue
            cand = drop_repeat(re.sub(r"^[Tt]he\s+", "", " ".join(run)).strip())
            cand = trim_to_tail(cand).strip(" ,;:|.")
            cand = strip_edge_connectors(cand)
            if is_valid(cand):
                best = cand
        if best:
            return dspy.Prediction(committee=str(best))

        out = self.fallback(email_body=body, disclaimer_snippet=snippet)
        name = str(getattr(out, "committee", "") or "").strip()
        name = re.sub(r"(?i)^paid\s+for\s+(and\s+authorized\s+)?by[:,]?\s*", "", name).strip()
        name = name.strip(" \"'*|")
        if name.endswith("."):
            lastw = name.split(" ")[-1][:-1]
            if lastw.lower() not in ABBREV and len(lastw) > 1:
                name = name[:-1].strip()
        name = re.sub(r"\s*\([^)]*(?:www\.|https?://|\.com|\.org|\.net)[^)]*\)\s*$",
                      "", name, flags=re.I)
        name = trim_address(name) or name
        name = drop_repeat(name)
        name = strip_edge_connectors(name) or name
        return dspy.Prediction(committee=name.strip(" ,;:|"))
